item.title: Port Vale reach FA Cup fifth round for first time in 30 years
item.description: League One strugglers Port Vale advanced to the FA Cup fifth round for the first time since 1996 after Ben Waine struck an extra‑time winner to defeat Bristol City at Vale Park. Waine decided the tie with eight minutes remaining, latching onto Andre Gray’s through-ball, rounding Joe Lumley and finishing from a tight angle to reward a disciplined and determined Vale performance. item.title: Liam Walsh fires Luton Town into the Vertu Trophy Final
item.description: Liam Walsh’s first Luton Town goal sealed a comeback victory and booked Jack Wilshere’s side a place in the Vertu Trophy Final, as the Hatters edged past Northampton Town 2-1. item.title: EFL Statement: Sky Bet Championship Play-Off Format
item.description: At a General Meeting today, EFL Clubs approved changes to expand the number of teams competing in the Sky Bet Championship Play-Offs from four to six, starting in the 2026/27 season. The decision is intended to increase the number of competitive fixtures during the closing stages of the campaign, while also giving two additional Clubs the opportunity to reach the Play-Off Final at Wembley Stadium and progress to the Premier League. item.title: Community Trust programme helps Grace take her football journey stateside
item.description: A student supported by Barnsley FC Community Trust is now pursuing her dream of playing football in the United States after combining sport and education through the Trust’s post-16 programme. Grace Lea’s journey highlights the positive impact that football-led education programmes can have in helping young people develop both academically and personally.
